CLASSIFY::defer
       Defers the classification of the flow to response.

SYNOPSIS
       CLASSIFY::defer

DESCRIPTION
       This command defers the classification of the flow to response (for HTTP - response message, for non-HTTP, opposite traffic
       direction from traffic initiator)

       * Note: APM / AFM / PEM license is required for functionality to work.

       CLASSIFY::defer

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       HTTP_REQUEST

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.4.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
